title: (2nd LD) Seoul stocks rebound over 2 pct on bargain hunting
caption:
Seoul's KOSPI index saw a major turnaround, climbing over 2% following a sharp decline. Investors are betting on the strength of local chip manufacturing despite international market jitters.

Source: En - (2nd LD) Seoul stocks rebound over 2 pct on bargain hunting
